summary: Manual scene-package code audit passed for games/cards.

public_task_objective_ownership.notes: The ten public task files own public task ids, supported query ids, objective-specific target/category/count resolution, sampler invocation, annotation binding choices, prompt query keys, and final generation entrypoints. The scene-private lifecycle handles neutral retry/render/prompt/output plumbing only.

shared_identity_free.notes: shared/ contains passive state, card components, rendering, sampling primitives, annotation projections, prompt loading, defaults, and trace-output fragments. Public task/query identity strings are owned by public task files; shared sampling uses internal generic pattern keys.

state_passive.notes: shared/state.py contains scene constants and passive dataclasses only. CardInstance lives there instead of in rendering.

rendering_role_boundary.notes: Card glyph drawing lives in shared/components.py, scene rendering wrappers live in shared/rendering.py, and neither routes by public task identity.

prompt_externalization.notes: User-facing prompt wording and examples live in prompts/games/cards/games_cards_v1.json. Task files provide prompt query keys and dynamic slots only.

config_no_routing.notes: configs/domains/games/cards.yaml keeps scene style axes in generation.shared and task-owned axes in task_overrides. It does not use query_id_weights, task dispatch, or task_group routing.

annotation_answer_binding.notes: Answers and annotations are bound from the same sampled card trace for count, rule-label, and missing-card query branches.

direct_smoke_generation.notes: Scene-scoped migration tests generated every active cards task and supported query id.

notes: This status makes games/cards eligible for review artifact generation only; human review in the browser app still decides acceptance.
